title: EarnApp probe accepted forged provider verdicts
description: The pre-fix EarnApp WSS qualification probe disabled TLS certificate and hostname verification. A malicious or compromised configured proxy could forge the provider WebSocket handshake and send cid_set, after which CashPilot persisted the result and treated the proxy as EarnApp-eligible for leasing.
root_cause: build_tls_context in app/proxy_probe_profiles/earnapp.py does not authenticate the WSS peer, allowing a proxy-side MITM to forge qualification verdicts.
intended_behavior: Only a response from the authenticated EarnApp WSS endpoint should qualify a proxy for EarnApp traffic.

trace.description: The recheck route invokes the EarnApp WSS probe for each selected proxy.
The probe starts TLS to proxyjs.brdtnet.com using the probe TLS context.
The probe accepts an ipc_post/cid_set frame and sets verdict CID_SET.
Latest matching CID_SET and eligible evidence is used to make a proxy leaseable for EarnApp.

conditions.description: The attacker must control or MITM a configured proxy route used by the qualification probe.
The probe must reach the EarnApp WSS qualification endpoint through that route.

execution.attacker_perspective: A malicious or compromised proxy operator whose route is selected for EarnApp qualification.
payloads: A forged TLS/WebSocket session containing tunnel_init followed by ipc_post/cid_set.
instructions: Cause the qualification request to traverse the controlled proxy route.
Present a forged WSS session and CID_SET response.
Allow the normal recheck and eligibility persistence path to process the response.
execution.expected_result: Before the fix, the proxy was recorded as CID_SET/eligible and could enter EarnApp lease selection without an authenticated provider response.

remediation.strategy: Require certificate-chain and hostname verification for the fixed provider WSS host; use a narrowly scoped explicit CA only if provider-approved interception is unavoidable.

code_changes.fixed_code: build_tls_context now uses ssl.create_default_context() with check_hostname=True and verify_mode=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED.
Regression test asserts hostname checking and CERT_REQUIRED.

likelihood.reason: Requires control or MITM of a configured proxy route.

impact.reason: Can redirect EarnApp traffic through an unqualified attacker-controlled proxy, but does not directly compromise the CashPilot server.

confidence.reason: Independent validation traced the complete pre-fix flow from disabled TLS verification through CID_SET persistence and eligibility SQL; targeted regression tests pass after remediation.
